app.title: Data Pipeline Builder
app.subtitle: Import, transform, link and export tabular data
start.heading: Start a pipeline
start.existing.help: Pick a pipeline you saved earlier. It re-reads the same folders, so a monthly job is one click.
start.new.help: Start from scratch: import your files, set up the linking fields, combine the tables and export.
start.none: No saved pipelines yet. Create one and save it at the last step.
start.name: Pipeline name
start.root.help: File paths are saved relative to this folder, so the pipeline still works if the whole folder moves or is copied.
src.heading: Import files
src.help: Add each data file and each mapping document. Everything is read as text so that leading zeros and long reference numbers survive intact.
src.label: Name
src.header: First row holds the column names
src.skip: Rows to skip before the header
keys.heading: Linking fields
keys.help: Clean up the fields you will match on. Reference numbers rarely line up between systems: strip the punctuation, pad the zeros back on, and the join will find them.
keys.output.help: Leave as the original name to overwrite it, or give a new name to keep both.
keys.none: No transformations yet. You can also skip this step if your keys already match.
join.heading: Combine tables
join.help: Choose the table that drives the output, then link the others onto it one at a time.
join.base.help: Every row of this table becomes a row of the result.
join.type.right: Keep all rows of the linked table (right join)
join.type.semi: Keep base rows that have a match (filter only)
join.type.anti: Keep base rows with no match (find the gaps)
join.select.help: Leave empty to bring everything except the matching fields.
join.conflict.skip: Leave the original, drop the incoming
join.multi: If the linked table has duplicate keys
join.matchblanks: Let blank keys match each other
join.none: No links yet. With one table you can go straight to the final step.
join.check.result: {matched} of {total} base rows found a match; {unmatched} did not.
final.heading: Final table
final.help: Choose which columns to keep, rename them, put them in order, and apply any last formatting.
final.none: Import and combine your files first.
export.heading: Export & save
export.timestamp: Add a date and time to the filename
export.save.help: Saves to the pipelines folder. You can then re-run it from the first screen, or from the command line with run_pipeline.R.
export.cli: Re-run from a scheduler or batch file
export.engine.missing: DuckDB is not installed; running in R. Install it with install.packages("duckdb").
export.engine.fallback: Will run in R: no exact SQL equivalent for {ops}.
run.success: Wrote {rows} rows and {cols} columns to {path} in {secs}s.
